content.rendered:
Picture day is on Monday, September 22nd! You may place online orders now at mydorian.com and for up to 4 days after picture day.
 
For picture day, students must wear uniform or nicer attire – please no jeans. All students will get their picture taken as part of their school record, even if you chose not to order any photos.
